statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for the patient
The patient has a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
Diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.9, and R55 were assigned
The monitoring was indicated to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
Shorter-duration recording could not accomplish the clinical goals
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
